findings.title: Border width max ignores units
findings.message: The styler runs on every restyle and reads s.Border after the base style has been applied. The unit may not be Dp, so the max comparison against 2 mixes units. When focused, s.Border is replaced with MaxBorder, and subsequent style passes see it as the base width, so the logic is fine, but non-Dp units would be wrong.
findings.suggestion: Convert the width to Dp (or use .Dots) before comparing, or use the explicit configured border width from the resolved style.

findings.title: Pending flag can be stuck true when post is refused
findings.message: If postControl returns false for a reason other than window context cancellation (e.g. queue refusal), the pending flag stays true. The comment says a refresh is requested, but if the refresh is never consumed by syncControl for this record, later focus events are dropped by the CompareAndSwap guard and the outline never restyles.
findings.suggestion: Clear the pending flag whenever the post is not accepted and no refresh is guaranteed, or ensure Invalidate is always called. Also guard against a nil c.windowRef before calling Context().
